quotations.old_english: Tō beddreáfe genihtsumige tō hæbbenne meatte and hwītel
Hí ne mihton hine beran būton on ānum hwītle

source_text: hw&i-long;tel. Add :-- T&o-long; beddreáfe genihtsumige t&o-long; hæbbenne meatte and hw&i-long;tel (sagum, R. Ben. 90, 15. H&i-long; ne mihton hine beran b&u-long;ton on &a-long;num hw&i-long;tle (sago), Gr. D. 125, 18. R&u-long;hne hw&i-long;tel (printed Haken,
